name: Kibo UI
summary: Docs introduction for a component library and custom registry extending shadcn/ui with higher-level components.
description: Kibo UI is a component library and custom registry on top of shadcn/ui that provides higher-level React components — tables, file dropzones, AI chat primitives, calendars, rich text editors and drag-and-drop — plus blocks for whole sections like login pages and dashboards. Open source (MIT) and built for React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS stacks.
contains: higher-level components: tables, file dropzones, AI chat primitives
blocks for login pages, dashboards and other app sections
